culprit_citations.quoted_text: Nexpoint Real Estate Finance, Inc. | Shares 65,670

findings.detail: All six common-stock positions have source share counts, but they are absent from the extracted rows, reducing coverage from 14 of 14 to 8 of 14.

rationale: The filing schedule labels cell 15 as Shares at table 17 row 27. Each of the six common-stock positions at rows 30, 33, 36, 37, 42, and 45 contains a numeric share count in that column; the two LLC-interest and six preferred-stock positions likewise contain share counts. The raw-source coverage is therefore 14 of 14 (100%), while C04 observed only 8 of 14 (57.1%). The missing six align exactly with the common-stock block, proving a localized shares-column extraction gap.
